question: A person who received a blood transfusion 6 months ago is eligible to donate blood at a voluntary donation camp today.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is false. Prior blood transfusion is a permanent deferral criterion for voluntary blood donation, not a 6-month deferral. This is a key point to communicate during donation counselling.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this is false. Recipients of blood transfusions are permanently deferred from voluntary blood donation in India (and in most national guidelines) because of the risk of transmitting transfusion-transmissible infections.
